name: Layer-Based Cube Traversal
definition: Traverses a 3D grid of cubes layer by layer, maintaining only two layers in memory to reduce space complexity while fetching corner data for each cube.
summary: Layer-Based Cube Traversal is a memory-optimized Marching Cubes implementation that reduces spatial complexity to O(N^2) by processing z-slices one at a time and maintaining only two voxel layers in memory.
